Canopy · Bud Empire

Privacy

Last updated 23 September 2026

Canopy does not collect personal information. There is no account, no sign-in, and no profile. Your game is saved on your own device and stays there.

What is stored, and where

Canopy keeps everything it needs in your browser's local storage on the device you play on:

  • Your save — money, stations, staff, strains, branches and progress, plus one recent backup copy.
  • Your settings — sound, ambience, day or night, and whether you have seen the start guide.
  • Your age-gate answer, so you are not asked on every visit.

None of this is transmitted anywhere. It is not backed up to us, because there is no "us" server holding game data. Clearing your browser's site data, or uninstalling the app, deletes it permanently.

Backing up your save

Settings offers Back up save and Restore save. Export writes a file to your device and nothing more — the file is not uploaded, and we never see it. Restoring reads a file you choose and replaces the shop in this browser. Where you keep that file, and who you share it with, is entirely up to you.

Analytics

Canopy contains code for a small number of anonymous milestone events — first session, finishing the start guide, opening a branch — intended for a cookieless analytics provider that records no personal data and no cross-site identifiers.

No analytics provider is currently loaded, so nothing is sent at all. If one is ever enabled, the events carry no name, no email, no account, no device identifier and no advertising ID — only a short event name and small numbers such as a level. You can silence them permanently on your device by setting canopy-telemetry to off in local storage.

What Canopy never does

  • No advertising, and no advertising or attribution SDKs.
  • No in-app purchases and no payment processing — nothing in the game is for sale.
  • No accounts, sign-in, email collection or newsletters.
  • No location, contacts, photos, camera, microphone or health data.
  • No selling or sharing of personal information, because none is collected.
  • No third-party trackers, tracking pixels or cross-app tracking.

Children

Canopy is a work of fiction about running a dispensary and is intended for adults. An age check appears before the game starts. The game is not directed at children, and no information is knowingly collected from anyone.

Hosting

The web version is served as static files. As with any website, the host that delivers those files may record ordinary technical request logs, such as an IP address and browser type, for security and reliability. Those logs belong to the hosting provider, are not used to build a profile of you, and are not combined with anything from the game. Installed versions of Canopy run from files already on your device and can be played with no network connection at all.

Your choices

Because nothing leaves your device, you are already in control of all of it. To erase everything Canopy has stored, use Start over in Settings, clear site data for this site in your browser, or uninstall the app. To keep a copy first, export your save.

Changes

If this policy changes, the date at the top changes with it. Material changes will be noted on the page rather than made quietly.

Contact

Questions about this policy can be sent to the address listed on the Canopy page.
